Assertions 1-4 pass for every run; only assertion 5 (separate plan vs implement prompt) discriminates. Add a harder check, e.g. that the response flags the sample file crashes on '2.5' before reaching the blank line, or that the first implementation prompt includes the not-counted-as-skipped rule.

eval_feedback.overall: Weakly discriminating: 4 of 5 assertions are saturated.
